FIR records vehicle number + BNS rash/negligent driving provisions; activist tagged DGP seeking action
bullets_en: RTI activist Robin Zaccheus alleges police omitted GHMC officials from his accident FIR.
He was hit by a speeding car near a railway overbridge in Secunderabad on Thursday night.
His 6-page complaint named GHMC engineers and contractors, but the FIR copy does not.
He has tagged the DGP on social media, seeking action over the pothole-ridden road.
bullets_ur: RTI activist Robin Zaccheus ka ilzam hai ki unke accident ki FIR mein GHMC officials ke naam nahi likhe gaye.
Thursday raat Secunderabad mein railway overbridge ke paas ek tez car ne unhe takkar maari thi.
Unke 6-safha complaint mein GHMC engineers aur contractors the, magar FIR copy mein nahi.
Unhone DGP ko tag karke karwai ki maang ki hai aur sadak ko deathtrap qarar diya hai.
